issues.display_title: Issue #1756: Add Artworks dialog: remove unused video upload and make drop area full width
issues.main_description_html:
Context

The Add Your Artworks dialog used to be a two-column layout: file drop area on the left, video URL input on the right. The video upload path is no longer used, so the right column is gone and the drop area is left sitting in half the dialog width.

Changes

  • AddVideoComponent marked @deprecated and removed from AddImageComponent imports (was triggering NG8113: AddVideoComponent is not used within the template of AddImageComponent on build).
  • files-handler drop area now fills the full dialog width:
    • :host { display: block; flex: 1 } — the custom element defaulted to display: inline, so it shrink-to-fit as a flex item.
    • .drop-area width: 348px → 100%.
    • .left-content padding 0 92px, .content-add padding-right: 21px so left and right gutters match (114px each).
  • Drop area converted from div[role="button"][tabindex] to a native <button type="button">: free Enter/Space activation, [disabled] replaces tabindex="-1", plus :focus-visible ring and :disabled state. Label and hint wired via aria-labelledby / aria-describedby.

Files touched:

  • src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/images/add-image/add-image.component.ts
  • src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/images/add-image/add-video/add-video.component.ts
  • src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/images/add-image/files-handler/files-handler.component.html
  • src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/images/add-image/files-handler/files-handler.component.scss
  • src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/_artworks.scss

Remaining / follow-up

  • Decide whether to delete add-video/ entirely (component, template, SCSS, spec) instead of keeping it deprecated.
  • If deleted, drop the now-dead .input-url, .right-content, and .wrap-input-url rules in src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/_artworks.scss, plus getVideoData / getVideoType in ImagesService if nothing else calls them.

Demo by Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #1758: [Editor] Show a notice on video artworks instead of playing them
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Follow-up to #1756. That change removed the video upload option, so no new video artwork can be added. But galleries created earlier still contain video artworks, and those kept playing normally in the editor.

That is confusing: the video plays, so it looks supported, while the feature behind it is not.

What changed

Video artworks no longer play. The artwork canvas now shows a plain notice instead:

Video artwork is not available at the moment.

This applies to every video artwork, not only broken ones. Everything else about them stays the same — they keep their frame, passepartout, position and size, and can still be selected, moved and deleted.

One side effect worth noting: opening a gallery is a little faster. The editor used to call an external service once per video artwork to resolve its stream. That is gone, and with it a failure case that could leave the editor stuck on the loading screen.

Files touched:

  • src/app/shared/services/artwork-loader.service.ts
  • src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/editor.component.ts
  • src/assets/img/video-unavailable.png (new)

Note on the earlier approach

An earlier attempt showed this message as a hover tooltip instead of on the artwork itself. It was dropped in favour of putting the notice directly on the artwork, so it is visible without the user having to discover it.

Worth recording for whoever picks up video support later: the BabylonJS build used by the editor is not the same one the gallery uses. The editor build is missing pieces the gallery relies on for hover effects, so hover behaviour cannot simply be copied between the two projects.

Remaining / follow-up

  • Video upload code is now fully unused (AddVideoComponent and the video helpers in ImagesService). Decide whether to delete it or keep it for a future revival.
  • Align the BabylonJS builds used by villume-admin and villume-gallery so behaviour can be shared.

Verification

Build, type check, lint and formatting all pass. Still needs a manual check: open a gallery that contains a video artwork and confirm the notice shows up in place of the video.

issues.display_title: Issue #418: Show a notice on video artworks instead of playing them
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Video artwork is no longer a supported feature. The editor stopped offering video upload in GoThruMedia/villume-admin#1756, and now shows a notice in place of the video instead of playing it (GoThruMedia/villume-admin#1758).

The gallery still played those videos, so a visitor saw a working video for a feature that is not supported and no longer maintained. This brings the gallery in line with the editor.

What changed

Video artworks no longer play in the gallery. The artwork canvas shows a plain notice instead:

Video artwork is not available at the moment.

  • Applies at both quality levels, so the visitor never sees a video — not while the low quality version is up, and not after the original quality swap.
  • The artwork keeps its frame, passepartout, position and size, and still behaves normally otherwise.
  • The artwork list still shows the real video thumbnail. Only the 3D canvas changes.

Machinery that existed purely to play video is gone: the play/pause controller that started and stopped playback based on camera distance, and the "Loading…" panel that appeared on the artwork while the video buffered.

Files touched:

  • src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts
  • src/app/shared/services/artwork-loader.service.ts
  • src/app/shared/services/artwork-loader-viewer.service.ts
  • src/app/villume-gallery/villume-gallery.component.ts
  • src/assets/img/video-unavailable.png (new)

One deliberate difference from the editor

The editor dropped its call to the external video service entirely. The gallery keeps it, because the same response also carries the thumbnail rendered in the artwork list. Only the stream part is dropped.

That also removes a hang risk on the same line the editor had: the stream was read off a find() result inside an RxJS next handler, so when no entry matched, the throw skipped the error handler and the promise never settled — closely related to #416.

Remaining / follow-up

  • video_stream on IArtwork is now written nowhere. Remove it once the editor side is settled.
  • Decide whether the artwork list should keep showing the video thumbnail long term, or also switch to the notice for consistency.

Verification

Type check, lint and build all pass. Still needs a manual check: open a published gallery containing a video artwork, confirm the notice appears on the canvas and the thumbnail still shows in the artwork list.
